surface: Complete thinking-orbs 0.3.1 web component, preset, and framework-neutral engine surface.
divergences: Consumers import from @octanejs/thinking-orbs instead of thinking-orbs.
The component is authored in TSRX and uses Octane's native ref and effect lifecycle; its canvas, accessibility, animation, theme, and reduced-motion behavior match the React package.
ssr: Supported. SSR emits the accessible canvas shell; drawing and browser observers begin after client commit.
